decision_conditions: The proposed single storey side extension, by virtue of its siting, form, detailed design, materials, and proximity to the site boundary would appear incongruous and out of keeping with the host building and thereby harm the character and appearance of the Turkey Street Conservation Area as a designated heritage asset. This harm is not outweighed by planning benefits, contrary to Policies HE4, HE5, HE6 and HE9 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 and CP31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD14, DMD37 and DMD44 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), Turkey Street Conservation Area Character Appraisal (2015), Turkey Street Conservation Area Management Proposals (2015) and the Enfield Heritage Strategy 2019 - 2024 (2019).

The proposed single storey side extension, in the absence of an adequate flood risk assessment fails to demonstrate how proposed measures manage the risk of flooding, contrary to Policies F7 and F8 National Planning Policy Framework (2026), SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD60, DMD61, DMD62 and DMD63 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and Enfield Strategic Flood Risk Assessment (2021).
